title: Завершить controlled-production gate в owner-directed local-only scope
summary: После terminal P4.1 и GREEN P4.2 исполнить максимально безопасный local-only rehearsal, зафиксировать production `NO-GO` без трафика и закрыть item терминально с явным отклонением по D12. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/decisions/D12.json`).
why: Владелец не предоставляет production target и 72-часовое окно, поэтому первоначальный D10 заменён D12. Local evidence не сертифицирует production, но закрывает все доступные исполнителю recovery/readiness риски.

include: explicit D12 owner authorization; classified production preflight without traffic; local runtime readiness; local pipeline and crawler health; reversible worker interruption and storage outage recovery; focused fault tests; targeted broad and full application suites; static/style/security checks; sanitized terminal GO/NO-GO artifact and handoff.
exclude: any production access or traffic; 72-hour production observation; production metrics or reconciliation; nationwide crawl; permanent production enablement; SLA certification; destructive database or storage faults; B3 implementation; LLM accuracy certification.

rules: Start only after terminal P4.1 with resolved B2 and GREEN P4.2. Never synthesize a production target, profile, metric or elapsed duration. Keep production verdict `NO-GO`; label every runtime check local-only. Worker and MinIO interruption must be reversible and finish with readiness GREEN. Preserve missing production evidence as Known Deviation under D12 rather than as an implicit certification.
guidance: Classify the declared production Compose checks without inventing missing environment values. On `agelto_dev`, run readiness, pipeline stuck/status and crawler health; run the existing real-worker recovery contract; stop and restore only local MinIO behind an automatic restore trap; finish with readiness and service health GREEN. Run focused fault/recovery tests, targeted broad and full suites. Secrets and raw bodies never enter artifacts. Do not rewrite unrelated dirty application files to satisfy an inherited formatter migration.
